# M0-S5 I2: a nested loGo/s module does not reclassify its outer Go module.
# The outer Go module keeps the upstream CGO_ENABLED default under both
# commands, so its cgo package builds with `go build` and `logos build`.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Default CC: a host compiler setting must not drive the build.
env CC=

# No explicit CGO_ENABLED: the outer module must keep the upstream default,
# which is cgo on when a compiler is present.
env CGO_ENABLED=

[cgo] go build -o g-go.bin .
[cgo] logos build -o g-logos.bin .
[cgo] logos env CGO_ENABLED
[cgo] stdout '^1$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/g

go 1.27

-- main.go --
package main

/*
int answer() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("g:", C.answer()) }

-- sub/go.mod --
module example.com/g/sub

go 1.27

-- sub/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("sub") }
